jobs.title: Customer Experience (CX) Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
About the company

FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities. This multicultural team drives the company’s mission of reshaping financial services for underserved communities. To gain deeper insights into FairMoney’s pivotal role in reshaping Africa’s financial landscape, we invite you to watch an informative video.

Role Summary:

This role sits within the CX team and will be responsible for CX reporting, automation, process optimization, Freshworks administration, chatbot optimization, and driving cross-functional initiatives with Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own CX operational reporting and dashboards.
  • Build automated reports using SQL, BigQuery, and Tableau.
  • Administer the Freshworks suite (Freshdesk, Freshchat, Freshcaller), including workflows, automations, bot flows, tags, and reporting.
  • Drive CX automation and process improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to resolve customer pain points and implement improvements.
  • Lead weekly CX governance meetings and track action items to closure.
  • Monitor CX KPIs / OKRs and identify improvement opportunities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • 3+ years' experience in CX Operations, Contact Centre, Business Operations, Business Intelligence, or Process Improvement.
  • Strong SQL and BigQuery experience.
  • Strong Tableau dashboard development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Freshdesk/Freshchat/Freshcaller or other Freshworks products.
  • Strong stakeholder management and project coordination skills.
  • Experience working with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience in a Customer Experience or Contact Centre environment is an added advantage.

Nice to Have:

  • Chatbot/conversational AI experience.
  • Workflow automation and API integration experience.
  • Fintech, banking, or digital financial services experience.

Benefits

  • Private Health Insurance
  • Performance Bonus
  • Pension Plan
  • Training & Development

Recruitment Process

  • A screening call with a member of the recruitment team for 30 minutes.
  • Technical interview with the hiring manager for 30 to 60 minutes.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Identity)
jobs.description:
FairMoney is a credit-led mobile bank for emerging markets. The company was launched in 2017, operates in Nigeria & India, and raised close to €50m from global investors like Tiger Global, DST & Flourish Ventures.

You will be working as a Engineering Manager (Identity) in our Technology Division, which is now composed of 75+ people in Lagos, Bangalore, Paris, Türkiye, and remotely across the globe.

We are building Engineering centres of excellence across multiple regions and are looking for smart, talented, driven engineers. This is a unique opportunity to be part of the core engineering team of a fast-growing fintech poised for more rapid growth in the coming years.

FairMoney is a 100% digital bank that is revolutionizing the traditional banking industry. Our mission is to make financial services accessible and convenient for everyone through the use of technology.

As an Engineering Manager (Identity) at FairMoney, you will lead an engineering squad responsible for building and maintaining reliable identity and KYC solutions that support our products and customers across markets.

You will combine strong people leadership with a hands-on technical background, working closely with engineers, Product, Risk, Compliance, and other stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions. You will play a key role in shaping the squad’s technical direction, engineering practices, and overall performance.

If you are an experienced engineering leader who enjoys developing people, solving complex technical problems, and building reliable systems in a financial services environment, we want you to join our team!

We are looking forward to having you work on:

· Leading, mentoring, and developing engineering squads while fostering a strong culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement;

· Providing technical leadership for identity, authentication, KYC, and related backend systems;

· Working closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into reliable technical solutions;

· Driving the design, development, and delivery of scalable and resilient distributed systems;

· Ensuring high standards across architecture, code quality, testing, security, reliability, and engineering practices;

· Supporting engineers in solving complex technical challenges and making sound engineering decisions;

· Managing team performance, growth, hiring, and development while ensuring the squad has the right skills and support to succeed;

· Monitoring system performance and reliability, identifying areas for improvement, and driving continuous technical improvements;

· Contributing to engineering strategy and helping shape the technology roadmap for Identity.

🔧 Our Technical Stack

· Our customer-facing product is an Android application;

· It communicates with Ruby on Rails or Go-lang backends (Sidekiq, RSpec);

· Our ML pipeline is API-Flask (Python);

· We are hosted on AWS: Kubernetes, SNS, SQS, Lambdas, RDS Aurora MySQL and PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3, and Kinesis;

· Prototype of a data warehouse on GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Cloud Composer);

· We run our CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

· 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with experience in a backend engineering environment;

· 2+ years of experience managing software engineering teams;

· Strong hands-on experience with backend development and distributed systems;

· Experience designing, building, and operating scalable and reliable production systems;

· Strong understanding of software engineering principles, architecture, testing, CI/CD, and system reliability;

· Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills;

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;

· Experience working in cross-functional teams and collaborating closely with Product and other business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience working on identity, authentication, KYC, onboarding, fraud prevention, or related financial services systems;

· Experience working in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated financial services environment;

· Strong experience with Go, Ruby/Rails, or another backend programming language;

· Experience building and operating distributed, event-driven, or microservices-based systems;

· Experience working with AWS or other major cloud platforms;

· Experience leading engineering teams through complex technical projects and organisational change;

· Experience mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership within a team.

Benefits

  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development

Recruitment Process

  • Screening call with a member of the recruitment team for 30 minutes.
  • Technical interviews with members of the Engineering team for 45-60 minutes.
